verdict.rationale: Modal explicitly positions Sandboxes as secure, isolated containers for running untrusted user/agent code (modal-docs-1, modal-probe-2) and has a dedicated networking/security guide (modal-docs-10), implying credential/network isolation by design. However, no evidence explicitly details a secrets-management model proving host credentials are specifically walled off from sandboxed code (no mechanism description, no independent security audit, no hands-on confirmation of credential unreachability). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of secrets/credential isolation mechanics, independent security testing or audit, and confirmation from community that secrets cannot leak into sandbox code.
